sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: PASS: AAP Antarctic geography L306 explicitly says Antarctica is surrounded by the Southern Ocean, which connects Atlantic, Indian and Pacific. In this five-ocean convention the direct encircling ocean is uniquely Southern Ocean. Arctic surrounds the other pole; Atlantic and Indian meet Southern Ocean but do not individually surround all Antarctica. The prompt’s непосредственно makes the modern ocean-boundary convention clear enough without requiring a date.
